fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the Florida Recovery Act aimed at chain stores and on Florida newspaper publishers' opposition; coverage of Miami municipal election campaigning and candidates; reporting and opinion on a jewel-robbery investigation involving Detective Chief Eugene I. Bryant and references to federal grand jury proceedings; a published letter urging major local employers to help employees avoid predatory small-loan firms; a lawsuit claim involving diathermic treatment at Coral Gables Clinic; columns on local gambling and nightlife (including the Beach Club at Palm Beach) and promotional features such as Kentucky Derby selections and local entertainment advertising.
